request.text: I'm standing in front of you rehearsing the opening of my thesis defense. Please look at me now so I can practice speaking to an audience.

responsibilities.outcome: Direct the robot's gaze toward the user standing in front of it so the user can rehearse the thesis-defense opening for an audience.

semantic_facts: The candidate should direct gaze toward the requesting person identified by the user's deictic wording and should not add movement or evaluation of the rehearsal.
forbidden_claims: The robot is already looking at the user before execution evidence exists.
The assistant watched, assessed, or approved the thesis-defense rehearsal.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Deictic person grounding is lost, causing an unnecessary clarification or the wrong embodied capability.
A gaze action is inflated into unsupported claims about observing or evaluating the presentation.
